nodes.label: Luffy pays rent — weekly verdict read off the venue
nodes.rationale: The verdict reads the venue's income ledger because the journal booked exits above their fills (demo market orders return no average/price); death is a human act, so Luffy reports and never shuts itself down or deletes anything.

nodes.label: Rent ledger
nodes.rationale: Net counts only trading income (REALIZED_PNL, COMMISSION, FUNDING_FEE); transfers never count because moving money in is not earning it, and an unreadable ledger is UNKNOWN, never PASS — missing information is not a fabricated value.
